# MB-GATE-SEE-REQUIRED-FOR-SYSTEM-WORK-001

Purpose: Enforce that any system-level work (schemas, gates, invariants, memory/index/boot/validator changes) is backed by a SEE Evidence Set artifact.

This gate validates:
- Presence of a see_evidence_set artifact for qualifying turns
- Minimum source count and diversity
- Traceability from BTS decisions to SEE claims (optional strict mode)

Inputs:
- BTS Decision v2 record(s) (JSON)
- Action Classification (JSON)
- Optional target list derived from turn intent
- SEE Evidence Set artifact(s) (JSON)

Output:
- Gate receipt (PASS/FAIL/WARN) with violations array
